degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor's Degree of Medicine

description.text: School of pharmacy The department of pharmaceutics is one of the academic departments in theschool of pharmacy. The academic policy of the Department of pharmaceutics is to produce graduates with well-round scholastic activities, good morality and professional etiquette, and experiences in pharmaceutics. This department offers excellent infrastructure, which includes laboratories having advanced instrumental facilities, well furnished classrooms, seminar room etc. The department is now involved in a variety of academic programmes. The department provides a broad based education background emphasizing the theoretical and practical disciplines essential for the dosage form design, evaluation and manufacture, and development of raw material for pharmaceutical applications. Class will begin until the applicants reach to 20 Employment Orientation Graduates are supposed to undertake teaching and oral diseases treatments in medical schools, hospitals and clinics at all levels. Fees Application: 130USD Tuition: RMB20000(3175USD) Accommodation: RMB5000(794USD) Residence permit & photos: RMB840(133USD) Medical examination: RMB406(64USD) Book: RMB800(127USD) Beddings: RMB500(79 USD) Accomodation deposit: RMB 400(63USD) Incurance: RMB 600(95USD) White Doctor Coat: RMB120(19USD) Library card: RMB10(1.5USD) Student Card: RMB10(1.5USD) Total:RMB 29486 (4682USD)/First year RMB7240 (4324USD) per year for the next three years Click here for Fee Structure for Pharmacy(English Medium) Degree Awarded Bachelor's Degree of Medicine Teacher Highlight Jing Bi (Professor of Neurobiology, Subject Leaderof Liaoning Medical University) Junjian Chen (Distinguished Professor of Genetics, Subject Leader of Liaoning Medical University) Huibing Tan(Professor of Anatomy, Head of Teaching Research Office of Anatomy) Lihua Li(Vice Professor of Cytobiology, Vice Director of Teaching Research Office of Cytobiology)

duration.text: The Pharmacy at Jinzhou Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 5. Sponsorship Certificate You can click here to download the sample 6.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1. Applicant is under the age of 25 2. Be in good health 3. High-school graduate with good marks
